- Cookie

VISITOR\_PRIVACY\_METADATA

- Duration

6 months

- Description

YouTube sets this cookie to store the user's cookie consent state for the current domain.


Functional

Functional cookies help perform certain functionalities like sharing the content of the website on social media platforms, collecting feedback, and other third-party features.

- Cookie

li\_gc

- Duration

6 months

- Description

Linkedin set this cookie for storing visitor's consent regarding using cookies for non-essential purposes.


- Cookie

lidc

- Duration

1 day

- Description

LinkedIn sets the lidc cookie to facilitate data center selection.


- Cookie

VISITOR\_INFO1\_LIVE

- Duration

6 months

- Description

A cookie set by YouTube to measure bandwidth that determines whether the user gets the new or old player interface.


- Cookie

ytidb::LAST\_RESULT\_ENTRY\_KEY

- Duration

Never Expires

- Description

The cookie ytidb::LAST\_RESULT\_ENTRY\_KEY is used by YouTube to store the last search result entry that was clicked by the user. This information is used to improve the user experience by providing more relevant search results in the future.


Analytics

Analytical cookies are used to understand how visitors interact with the website. These cookies help provide information on metrics such as the number of visitors, bounce rate, traffic source, etc.

- Cookie

\_ga\_\*

- Duration

1 year 1 month 4 days

- Description

Google Analytics sets this cookie to store and count page views.


- Cookie

\_ga

- Duration

1 year 1 month 4 days

- Description

Google Analytics sets this cookie to calculate visitor, session and campaign data and track site usage for the site's analytics report. The cookie stores information anonymously and assigns a randomly generated number to recognise unique visitors.


- Cookie

\_hjSessionUser\_\*

- Duration

1 year

- Description

Hotjar sets this cookie to ensure data from subsequent visits to the same site is attributed to the same user ID, which persists in the Hotjar User ID, which is unique to that site.


- Cookie

\_hjSession\_\*

- Duration

1 hour

- Description

Hotjar sets this cookie to ensure data from subsequent visits to the same site is attributed to the same user ID, which persists in the Hotjar User ID, which is unique to that site.


- Cookie

invoca\_session

- Duration

1 year 1 month 4 days

- Description

Invoca sets this cookie to register statistical data on users' behaviour on the website for internal analytics by the website operator.


- Cookie

\_\_hstc

- Duration

6 months

- Description

Hubspot set this main cookie for tracking visitors. It contains the domain, initial timestamp (first visit), last timestamp (last visit), current timestamp (this visit), and session number (increments for each subsequent session).


- Cookie

hubspotutk

- Duration

6 months

- Description

HubSpot sets this cookie to keep track of the visitors to the website. This cookie is passed to HubSpot on form submission and used when deduplicating contacts.


- Cookie

\_\_hssrc

- Duration

session

- Description

HubSpot cookie sets this cookie to determine if the visitor has restarted their browser. If this cookie does not exist when HubSpot manages cookies, it is considered a new session.


- Cookie

\_\_hssc

- Duration

1 hour

- Description

HubSpot sets this cookie to keep track of sessions. This is used to determine if HubSpot should increment the session number and timestamps in the \_\_hstc cookie. It contains the domain, viewCount (which  increments with each pageview in a session), and session start timestamp.


- Cookie

YSC

- Duration

session

- Description

YSC cookie is set by Youtube and is used to track the views of embedded videos on Youtube pages.


Performance

Performance cookies are used to understand and analyse the key performance indexes of the website which helps in delivering a better user experience for the visitors.

- Cookie

\_uetsid

- Duration

1 day

- Description

Bing Ads sets this cookie to engage with a user that has previously visited the website.


- Cookie

\_uetvid

- Duration

1 year 24 days

- Description

Bing Ads sets this cookie to engage with a user that has previously visited the website.


Advertisement

Advertisement cookies are used to provide visitors with customised advertisements based on the pages you visited previously and to analyse the effectiveness of the ad campaigns.

- Cookie

\_gcl\_au

- Duration

3 months

- Description

Google Tag Manager sets this cookie to experiment advertisement efficiency of websites using their services.


- Cookie

\_fbp

- Duration

3 months

- Description

Facebook sets this cookie to store and track interactions.


- Cookie

bcookie

- Duration

1 year

- Description

LinkedIn sets this cookie from LinkedIn share buttons and ad tags to recognize browser IDs.


- Cookie

\_reb2bloaded

- Duration

Less than a minute

- Description



Description is currently not available.


- Cookie

test\_cookie

- Duration

15 minutes

- Description

doubleclick.net sets this cookie to determine if the user's browser supports cookies.


- Cookie

IDE

- Duration

1 year 24 days

- Description

Google DoubleClick IDE cookies store information about how the user uses the website to present them with relevant ads according to the user profile.


- Cookie

MUID

- Duration

1 year 24 days

- Description

Bing sets this cookie to recognise unique web browsers visiting Microsoft sites. This cookie is used for advertising, site analytics, and other operations.


- Cookie

\_\_Secure-YNID

- Duration

6 months

- Description

YouTube cookie used to protect user security and prevent fraud, especially during the login process.


- Cookie

\_\_Secure-ROLLOUT\_TOKEN

- Duration

6 months

- Description

YouTube sets this cookie to manage feature rollout and experimentation. It helps Google control which new features or interface changes are shown to users as part of testing and staged rollouts, ensuring consistent experience for a given user during an experiment.


- Cookie

\_\_Secure-YEC

- Duration

past

- Description

Description is currently not available.


Uncategorised

Other uncategorised cookies are those that are being analysed and have not been classified into a category as yet.

No cookies to display.

# Built for those who protect what matters most.

We believe every person deserves to feel safe, and every security professional deserves the tools to make that possible. Trackforce is the platform behind the people protecting our world.

Who we are

## 40+ years of expertise.   One modern platform.

Trackforce brings together the security industry’s most trusted technologies – TrackTik, GuardTek (EMEA), and Silvertrac.

Today thousands of customers run their security operations on Trackforce across 50+ countries and 55+ languages – from the guard on post to the boardroom.

![protection check white](https://www.trackforce.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/protection-check-white.svg)

### Protect what matters

Give every security team the visibility and control to keep people and places safe.

![quality check white](https://www.trackforce.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/quality-check-white.svg)

### Empower the people

Equip the guards on post and the leaders in command with tools that respect their work.

![global white](https://www.trackforce.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/global-white.svg)

### Everywhere it counts

Uphold that standard of protection across 50+ countries and 55+ languages.

What we believe

## The values behind   the platform.

### Safety is the mission

Every person deserves to feel safe. The work our customers do is serious – our software treats it with the weight it deserves.

### People first

We build for the guards on post and the leaders in the boardroom alike. Tools that respect the people who use them.

### Trust through proof

Visibility, accountability, and the data to back every decision.

Life at Trackforce

## Do the best work of your career – on a mission that matters.

We’re a global team of builders, operators, and problem-solvers united by one purpose: helping the people who keep the world safe. You’ll work alongside experts who’ve spent decades in security, ship software that protects real people every day, and grow in a culture that puts people first.

Our story

## Four decades of protecting   what matters most.

1980s

### The foundation

Decades of on-the-ground security expertise begin shaping what guarding operations really need.

2013

### TrackTik founded

Cloud-native security workforce management is born – connecting the field to the back office.

2021

### Trackforce Valiant

A landmark merger unites workforce management with enterprise back-office operations.

2022

### GuardTek (EMEA) & Silvertrac join

Field-first patrol and reporting platforms come together under one global company.

Today

### One platform

4,600+ customers across 50+ countries run their operations on a single, modern platform.
